description: TOUCHLINE OVERLAP COMMIT (offball, companion to overlap-auto.json). When the ball-carrier is pinned near the touchline the selector takes a second route that sets option bit 0x10 and commits the request immediately, bypassing the final same-side / carrier-y check at 0x143df0b77. That route almost never fires today: it needs the carrier within 6 m of the line, a defender within 20 deg of his facing AND within 4 m. Three re-aims widen it to 10 m from the line, 45 deg and 8 m. NOTE: bit 0x10 itself is INERT downstream - no instruction in the image tests it, and match::player::ActionOverlapSB::vf4 (0x1441d93b0) only reads bits 0-3, so the run still goes OUTSIDE. The gain here is purely that the request commits; a true underlap would need new code. Affects every AI-controlled player on both teams. Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/overlap-touchline-commit.json
